metrics.profile_summary: Senior Sales and Business Development professional with 20 years of experience in FMCG and telecommunications. Expert in retail operations, territory management, and leading large sales teams for national and multinational organizations.

experience.description: Manages retail operations and a team of 38 staff, overseeing annual turnover of PKR 45 Million and implementing KPI-based sales systems.

experience.role: Senior Territory Sales Manager - Dairy Business
experience.description: Led sales teams and distribution models for dairy products, coordinating with marketing to increase brand visibility and achieve business objectives.
Developed journey plans, managed distributor teams, and handled recruitment and training for the snacks and recipe business.
Led sales executives and field agents for broadband services, managing ATL/BTL marketing activities and outbound call centers.
Developed trade, retail, and wholesale accounts while achieving daily and annual sales targets across multiple territories.
Managed dealer relations, supervised pre-selling officers, and executed trade shows and promotional events to increase product visibility.

strengths: Strong background in FMCG and trade marketing
weaknesses: No experience with social media platforms (Instagram, TikTok, Facebook)
Lack of skills in Meta Business Suite, Canva, and UTM tracking
Overqualified in seniority for a Specialist role
evaluation.summary: The candidate is a highly experienced senior sales leader, but lacks the specific digital marketing and content creation skills required for this role.
